# Immutable mixed-license preservation fixtures

Source revision: `0b5d2297e7cbc19bd59cde750492dd28e3983ca0`.
Original instructional content © 2026 Rhys Jones, CC BY 4.0; implementation MIT.
Preferred attribution: *Discussion Skills Lab*, created by Rhys Jones, licensed
under https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ . Source is unadapted; interaction
records describe synthetic practice. Third-party materials are excluded.
Full authoritative notices are retained under `source/`.

`source/` and `source-index.json` are exhaustive archives, including unused variants.
`*-html.json` indexes exact text/attributes and meaningful markup by inert DOM path.
`banks.json` preserves original variable/item/option/answer/feedback associations.
`*-question-behavior.json` records every option's actual feedback in real UI journeys.
See `docs/content-inventory.md` for provenance, visibility and future destinations.
These files must not be automatically regenerated to hide a regression.
